title: A malformed pattern fails compilation with parse-failed, not empty matches
description: With the TypeScript grammar loaded, compilePattern('function (') must return ok:false/parse-failed. The negative assertion forbids treating the compile failure as 'no matches' or returning a partial pattern.

error.message_contains: Fails to parse the pattern query

error.message: Fails to parse the pattern query: `function (`

must_not: return ok:true with a partial pattern
return zero matches as a successful result
fall back to a substring/regex match
